headline: Bethany Beach Parking and State Park Entry Check
reservation: Bethany Beach manages seasonal downtown parking through a pay-by-app system typically active from mid-May through mid-September. Entry to the nearby Delaware Seashore State Park requires a separate daily vehicle fee or annual pass. Neither town parking nor park entry includes overnight accommodation, which must be secured independently through official rental agencies or hotels; always check current fee zones and reservation windows at the official town and state park sites.

days.title: Boardwalk Traditions and Local Flavor
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Ocean City Municipal Gateway

stops.name: Bethany Beach Boardwalk
stops.detail: Walk the half-mile wooden promenade to orient yourself with the 'Quiet Resort' atmosphere and local shops.

stops.name: Garfield Parkway
stops.detail: Visit the central hub for local seafood dining and independent bookstores within walking distance of the shore.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes from Ocean City; traffic varies significantly in summer.
days.note: Parking near the boardwalk fills early during peak July weekends.

days.title: Coastal Nature and Inland Bays

stops.name: Delaware Seashore State Park
stops.detail: Explore the trails near Indian River Inlet for views of the bridge and local birdwatching opportunities.

stops.name: Assawoman Wildlife Area
stops.detail: A short drive south offers a quiet, forested environment perfect for observing coastal marshes away from the beach crowds.

days.driving: Allow 20-30 minutes for local transfers between park areas.
days.note: State park amenities may have reduced hours outside of the June-September window.

days.title: Maritime History and Southern Sands

stops.name: Fenwick Island Lighthouse
stops.detail: View this historic 1858 marker on the Delaware-Maryland border to learn about regional maritime navigation.

stops.name: Fenwick Island State Park
stops.detail: Enjoy a less developed stretch of coastline ideal for shell collecting and quiet Atlantic views.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes to reach Fenwick Island; conditions vary by season.
days.note: Lighthouse interior access is seasonal and requires an official schedule check.

intel.title: Pay-to-Park Zones
intel.text: Bethany Beach uses digital payment apps for downtown street parking during summer months. Arrive before 10 AM to secure spots near the bandstand.

intel.title: Coastal Connectivity
intel.text: Cellular reception is generally stable along the Route 1 corridor. Signal may weaken inside the Assawoman Wildlife Area forested tracks.

intel.title: Highway Services
intel.text: Fuel stations are frequent along Route 1 between Rehoboth and Ocean City. Inland routes through Frankford offer fewer rapid-service options.

intel.title: Seasonal Pace
intel.text: September offers warm water with fewer crowds compared to the July peak. Many boardwalk kiosks transition to weekend-only hours by late October.

intel.title: Trolley Transit
intel.text: The seasonal town trolley serves major residential loops to reduce downtown congestion. Check the official town map for the current year's route stops.

plan.arrival: Pick up your rental at Ocean City (OCE) and drive north on Route 1. Stock up on supplies in Ocean City or Rehoboth before checking into your Bethany rental.
plan.vehicle: Standard sedans are suitable for all paved coastal roads; check rental terms for driving on unpaved wildlife area tracks.
plan.goldenHour: The Bethany Beach Shoreline offers expansive Atlantic views for sunrise, though cloud cover varies seasonally.
